features.Quick Hands: When a character triggers a Reactive Strike reaction from the thief, the thief can instead use their Pickpocket as a Reaction (without spending focus for a Reactive Strike).
features.Vanishing Act: If using cover at the end of their turn, make a Stealth test (no action required) against the enemies Spiritual Defense, each enemy that fails can no longer sense the thief.

Strike Dagger.Description: On a hit or graze, if the target is Disoriented, they take an extra 2 (1d4) keen damage.

Disorienting Distraction.Saving Throw: DC 13 Agility test or become Disoriented
Disorienting Distraction.Description: The thief throws sand, flour, or a similar substance to distract and confuse foes.

Pickpocket.Saving Throw: Thievery test against the target’s Perception
Pickpocket.Description: If the target is Disoriented, the target gains a disadvantage on their test. If the thief succeeds, they can choose to steal up to 50 marks or one item the target isn’t wielding or wearing.

Slippery.Description: After an enemy ends a Move action within 5 feet of the thief, the thief can use the Disengage action as a Reaction. If the thief ends this movement in cover or in an area where an enemy’s primary sense is obscured, enemies affected by that cover or obscured senses gain a disadvantage on attacks against the thief until the end of the thief’s next turn.
